title: 50 things to do instead of scrolling in bed
why: Fifty items is save bait; the app is the method slide and the closer asks a question.
caption: i said "5 more minutes" for 3 years (then made my phone go to sleep first) #bedtimeroutine #screentime #nightroutine #phoneaddiction
check: closer: 'i'm starting with #1'. Swap in what you're actually doing

slides.title:
50 things to do
instead of scrolling in bed
slides.aside: (save this for the next time you say "just 5 more minutes")

slides.heading: wind down
items: write one thing that went well
put your phone across the room
dim every light in the house

slides.heading: in bed, lights low
items: listen to one album start to finish
plan a trip you can't afford yet
write a letter you'll never send
journal the dumbest thing you saw today
plan your perfect day hour by hour
read a poem out loud, quietly

slides.heading: when you can't sleep
items: read the most boring book you own
body scan from your toes up
write down what's keeping you up, then close the notebook
open the window for cold air
name an animal for every letter
flip your pillow to the cold side
breathe in for 4, out for 8, ten times

slides.heading: the first 10 minutes
items: feet on the floor before anything
drink a full glass of water
walk to the kitchen and back
write one line about your dream

slides.heading: set up tomorrow night
items: pick a bedtime and keep it
charge your phone outside the bedroom
tell someone your bedtime so they can bully you
put a notebook by the bed

slides.heading: how i actually do it
slides.text:
at 11, my apps _go to sleep_

they don't wake up until i've _walked 200 steps_ in the morning

*(so this list is the only thing left to do in bed)*

slides.question: which one are you doing tonight? 👇
lines: i'm starting with #1. 10 pages, then lights out
locturne is in my bio if you want your apps to go to sleep too
